title: Monitoring the immune response to vaccination with an inactivated vaccine associated to bovine neonatal pancytopenia by deep sequencing transcriptome analysis in cattle.
ehr_evidence: For this study, jugular blood was taken i mmediately prior a further booster vaccination with PregSure® and 14 days later.
summary: Experimental RNAseq study monitoring the immune response to vaccination with an inactivated BVDV vaccine in cattle, identifying a novel cytokine-like gene and coordinated immune pathways.
key_findings: 2901 differentially expressed loci at a significance threshold of q < 0.05.
Novel locus XLOC_032517 showed a highly significant (p < 0.0001) 3.51 fold upregulation after vaccination.

Three cows that had never encountered PregSure® vaccination showed a significantly lower XLOC_032517 expression (p = 0.008) compared to the 12 cows which had received at least three PregSure® vaccinations.
Pathway analysis revealed coordinated immune response to dsRNA or a dsRNA analogue, upregulation of T cell response, and suppression of B cell activation.
population: 12 lactating and non-lactating cows aged three to five years (German Holstein × Charolais crossbred)
limitations: lack of functional annotation for novel locus XLOC_032517
